wikipedia.title: Madison Wind Farm
wikipedia.extract: The Madison Wind Farm was a power generation plant located in the town of Madison, New York, United States. Constructed in 1999-2000, it was the first wind farm completed in New York state and the first merchant wind farm in the country. The power plant consisted of seven Vestas V66-1.65 MW wind turbines, generating enough energy to power up to 10,000 homes. The Vestas V66-1.65 MW wind turbines had a hub height of 220 feet (67 m) and a 217 feet (66 m) rotor diameter totalling 330 feet (100 m) to the top of the rotor
